2016.emphasis_summary: The compensation excerpts emphasize peer benchmarking and 2015 operating highlights (immuno-oncology progress, clinical and regulatory achievements and business development), alongside board-qualification language.
2016.notable_shifts: First available year in sample; no prior-year comparison.

2017.emphasis_summary: The excerpts largely repeat the 2016 benchmarking and governance text, with the Benchmarking Process description now placed in the human-capital excerpt and a note on targeting total direct compensation above the primary peer median.
2017.notable_shifts: Little changed from 2016: the benchmarking description is newly placed in the human-capital excerpt, and the peer-positioning emphasis is unchanged.

2018.emphasis_summary: Supply-chain quality and integrity lead ('Drive supply chain leadership on quality and integrity', with suppliers in high-risk countries assessed for labor and integrity standards), alongside a cumulative indexed total shareholder return graph.
2018.notable_shifts: The 2018 text adds the supply-chain integrity commitments and a cumulative indexed total shareholder return graph, neither of which appears in the 2017 excerpts, while the peer benchmarking carries over.

2019.emphasis_summary: Supply-chain quality and integrity remains the lead, paired with Board-management partnership language and a reference to economic factors affecting healthcare systems' capacity to provide rapid, sustainable patient access.
2019.notable_shifts: The 2019 text repeats the 2018 supply-chain commitments and adds Board-management partnership and patient-access risk language.

2020.emphasis_summary: Company values and inclusion lead, with six values (passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, integrity and inclusion) and eight People and Business Resource Groups each focused on a dimension of diversity.
2020.notable_shifts: The 2020 excerpts move from the 2019 supply-chain integrity focus to a values-and-inclusion narrative, and R&D language (about 18 to about 45 hits) and diversity language (about 14 to about 26 hits) both roughly double or more.

2021.emphasis_summary: Values and the COVID-19 response lead, including the restated six values, a Board that met 13 times on the pandemic response and Celgene integration, and the sharing of discovery-library compounds and trials of Orencia and Eliquis.
2021.notable_shifts: COVID-19 becomes a board-level topic (13 Board meetings covering the response and the Celgene integration), and diversity language rises from about 26 to about 39 hits.

2022.emphasis_summary: Pandemic resilience and pipeline growth lead, with the company prioritizing workforce health and safety, relief efforts, a doubled pipeline, digital drug-discovery investment, and a reference to its first Diversity and Inclusion Report.
2022.notable_shifts: The 2022 text moves from the 2021 Celgene-integration and COVID-trial narrative toward a pipeline-doubling and digital-R&D message, and it references the first Diversity and Inclusion Report, issued the prior year.

2023.emphasis_summary: Diversity, equity and inclusion dominates, reporting 2022 results such as 58% of U.S. clinical trial sites in highly diverse communities and women at 48.7% of global executives, and including a shareholder proposal that criticizes DEI policies and seeks a civil rights audit.
2023.notable_shifts: This is the largest DEI shift in the sample: the 2023 excerpt adds 2022 DEI metrics and a shareholder proposal that attacks DEI policies and asks for a civil rights audit, text that appears in no other BMY year.

2024.emphasis_summary: CEO succession and board skills lead, reporting that Giovanni Caforio retired as CEO after an eight-year tenure with Chris Boerner taking over on November 1, 2023, and describing the Board's skills mix (science, manufacturing, regulatory compliance, commercialization).
2024.notable_shifts: The 2024 excerpts drop the 2023 DEI-proposal content and move to leadership transition and board-skills framing, with the inclusion and diversity goals referenced only in table-of-contents text.
